basic_info.description: Luxury living at Millennium! Situated on the 17th floor, this unit offers beautiful salesforce park and city views. The gourmet kitchen features sub-zero and Bosch appliances. The spacious bathroom includes a large shower, a soaking tub, and elegant limestone floors. Millennium Tower is San Francisco's best 5 star private residential building with full service amenities including 24 hour concierge service, 20,000 SF gym, Owner's Lounge with food service from International Smoke, private screening room, saline lap pool, spa/hot tub and more! A short walk to the Ferry Building, Financial District, Shopping and World Class Restaurants. Easy access to the Bay Bridge, highways 80/101/280, and public transportation. Don't miss this opportunity!
